channel.title: Dispatches — The Drowned Concordat
channel.description: Weekly real-world news on rising seas, flood defences and the future of food, from Hamish C. Rannoch.

item.title: Pumps on before the storm, and a glacier with less grip
item.description: The Netherlands starts pumping before Storm Boelo arrives, a new model doubles one Antarctic glacier's contribution to the sea, and the World Bank expects food to cost more. Three real stories from the week.

item.title: The wall is a system, and the menu is a gamble
item.description: London learns its sea is rising faster than it used to, and the companies betting on lab-grown meat are running short of money. Two real stories that could have come from behind the wall.
